<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="boss-profits" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Boss Profits</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel displays calculated GP/kill and related values for many commonly farmed bosses. The calculations use GE list prices, and auto update as the GE does. Drop rates are sourced from the Runescape Wiki.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="how-to-use-this-guide"><nowiki>How To Use This Guide</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To calculate your expected hourly profits </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/698816156961603654.png?v=1" alt="coins" title="coins" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for a given boss, take the listed GP/kill total and multiply it by your kills per hour (KPH). Any listed KPH rates below are based on the current meta farming methods, to allow for comparison between bosses.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>To use your own KPH values, visit the PvME spreadsheet </nowiki>[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1OGM9MBUG2bQVbHxlm86Xfs60soFcjINSOrPv1WL3Vgw/ <nowiki>here</nowiki>]<nowiki>, make a copy, and edit KPH values in the &quot;Boss Revenue&quot; sheet.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: The numbers provided do not take into account supply costs, with the exception of Magister and Legiones where key costs have been accounted for.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
